svg.title: Astrocartography map computed by xalen map
svg.desc: Indian independence, 15 August 1947, 00:00 IST (UTC+05:30), Delhi. MC, IC, ascendant and descendant lines of the Sun, Moon, Mercury, Venus, Mars, Jupiter and Saturn over a world coastline, with three parans.

g.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
g.text: Where each classical planet was rising (ASC), setting (DSC), culminating (MC) or anti-culminating (IC) at that moment
paran (two bodies on angles at once)
